u6d08ca37d3: The Jieli Technology 1-to-2 programmer (also commonly called a writer or programming device) is mainly used for offline programming (no PC connection is needed during programming) of firmware into the various Jieli chip series. It is suitable for scenarios in which bare chips are programmed first and then surface-mounted onto boards.
ue5ad7fe26e: It can program 2 target chips at the same time. It supports manual programming of target chips during development, and automatic programming of target chips together with an automatic programming handler in mass production.
u8567ebf7fb: Manual programming of bare chips requires a top board, and automatic programming of bare chips requires an adapter board. The 1-to-2 programmer mainly provides the following functions:
u118a923776: Programming of third-party data such as authentication codes
u7a4030b315: For detailed instructions on the programmer's functions and the configuration related to each function, see the corresponding sections!
u2d19545d4e: Controls the operation of the programmer
ub5f6b95e3a: Turns the main power on and off
u4453cc51d6: Forces an update of the programmer firmware⟦1/⟧ or sets the working mode
u7327b0d129: For upgrading the programmer firmware⟦1/⟧ and updating the target chip firmware
u10e3b2c1cb: Helps engineers debug when the programmer has problems
u8d0d39b8c4: Connects to a top board or an adapter board

u03116ce930: The socket board that holds the chip during automatic programming: a minimum chip system board used with the programmer⟦1/⟧ for programming on a handler

uf31fde2ee8: The following table describes the workflow.
ufb1f1f382c: The programmer firmware is already programmed before shipment,⟦1/⟧ so you can power on the programmer as soon as you receive it
u5f03669dc0: Check or update the programmer firmware
uebb82af664: The programmer firmware is the firmware of the main control chip that controls the operation of the whole programmer.⟦1/⟧ Before programming target chip firmware, be sure to check whether the current programmer firmware is the latest version.⟦2/⟧ If it is not, update the programmer firmware to the latest version through remote upgrade⟦3/⟧ (except in special cases); otherwise some programming problems may occur.
u61dbef184d: Check or update the target chip firmware
uc6dc66f3e2: The target chip firmware is the fw file, ufw file or key file generated by building the SDK project.⟦1/⟧ The file must be updated to and stored in the programmer⟦2/⟧ so that the corresponding data can be programmed into the target chip, or used for verification and blank check.⟦3/⟧ When updating the target chip firmware, you also need to configure the programming configuration items⟦4/⟧ to enable functions such as resource programming and chip performance testing
u1e7587efce: Check or set the programmer working mode
u6331b92430: The working modes are programming, verification, blank check, etc.⟦1/⟧ Be sure to check the current working mode of the programmer to avoid programming problems
ube6b9ee3bd: Program the chip firmware manually or automatically
u98af129480: Manual programming means programming chips by hand using a top board;⟦1/⟧ automatic programming means programming automatically through an adapter board under the control of an automatic programming handler
u0520846449: ⟦1⟧Programmer⟦/1⟧: also called a writer or programming device. A tool used to write data into programmable integrated circuits (such as microcontrollers, flash memory, OTP, etc.). In Jieli documents, tool interfaces, displays and so on, the terms ⟦2⟧burn⟦/2⟧ (烧录) and ⟦3⟧write⟦/3⟧ (烧写) mean the same thing (programming).
uf37537e20e: ⟦1⟧Top board⟦/1⟧: the socket board that holds the chip during manual programming, that is, the minimum chip system board used with the programmer for manual programming. It converts the vpp 6.5v voltage output by the programmer into the voltages needed to program the chip, such as 4.2v, and brings out the programming lines that connect to the programmer. To program development boards or devices with already-mounted chips directly, see the "Chip Programming Wiring and Power Supply" section.
u12c3e8444a: ⟦1⟧Adapter board⟦/1⟧: mainly converts the programmer's pin header signal lines into a general-purpose interface, used to connect the adapter socket board and the automatic programming signal lines during automatic programming.
u41ef9c9c2d: ⟦1⟧Adapter socket board⟦/1⟧: the socket board in which the robotic arm conveniently places the chips during automatic programming, that is, the minimum chip system board used with the programmer for programming on a handler. Like the top board, it can also be used for manual programming.
u0687cac84d: ⟦1⟧Bare chip⟦/1⟧: generally, a chip that has not yet been mounted on a device.
ueaa57308b5: ⟦1⟧Blank chip⟦/1⟧: a chip that has not been programmed since leaving the factory; usually this means that the chip's flash, hardware storage media, etc. contain no data.
u4a150d8adf: ⟦1⟧Programmer firmware⟦/1⟧: the firmware that controls the operation of the whole programmer.
u0ad9317a0a: ⟦1⟧Target chip firmware⟦/1⟧: executable files such as fw and ufw files generated by building the SDK (software development kit). They can be programmed into the chip with the programmer, where they run and control the operation of the whole product.
uf5b906558e: ⟦1⟧Offline programming⟦/1⟧: programming without a PC. With the 1-to-2 programmer, the target chip firmware is first deployed from a PC to the programmer's memory and stored there, and the chips are then programmed offline.
u26aa92ef9f: ⟦1⟧fw file⟦/1⟧: an executable program for the target chip, commonly used to program blank chips.
u120b47d57d: ⟦1⟧ufw file⟦/1⟧: an executable program for the target chip, mainly used to update or upgrade the program of a device chip that can already run, for example via a test box, an SD card or a USB flash drive. Upgrading with the programmer is also supported.
u8c61abfd8a: ⟦1⟧key file⟦/1⟧: a key file. Once the key file is configured in download.bat in the download directory, the data of the generated fw/ufw files is encrypted. When the fw/ufw file data is programmed, the key file data is programmed into the chip's hardware storage medium, and when the chip runs, the hardware decrypts the program data so that the program can run. Each customer's programmer key file is unique: every customer has their own key file, and programming is possible only if the key file of the fw file matches the key file of the programmer. Only mass-production programmers support programming key files. You can also program the key file on its own first, and then program an fw file with the key file using other programming tools.

u0ae7cf7248: Checking and updating the programmer firmware version
u31d7f7eab0: The programmer firmware is the firmware of the main control chip that controls the operation of the whole programmer. Before programming target chip firmware, be sure to check whether the current programmer firmware is the latest version (except in special cases); otherwise some programming problems may occur.
ua5e529be09: After the programmer is powered on and has displayed the "Jieli LOGO", it displays the current programmer firmware version number for 2 seconds (the programmer firmware version number is also shown in the interface for updating the target chip firmware), as shown in ⟦1⟧Programmer firmware version display⟦/1⟧.
uea27cdcc91: Regularly check for new versions and update the programmer firmware
uad5afb543e: If the firmware version used by the programmer is outdated, the PC tool interface for updating the target chip firmware fw file shows a corresponding update prompt. If new firmware is available, update promptly.
ud4b919cac1: Open the PC tool control panel for remote upgrade of the programmer firmware to get the 3 latest programmer firmware version numbers, and select the version you need to upgrade to. For the upgrade steps, see ⟦1⟧Remote Upgrade of the Programmer Firmware⟦/1⟧.
ue73054dcd7: Deploying the target chip firmware to the programmer
u808496c57c: Before programming, verifying or blank-checking chips, you need to deploy the programming firmware for the target chip, that is, the fw file, ufw file or key file generated by building the SDK, to the programmer. During the process, the programmer programs this firmware into the target chip, or uses it for verification and blank check. If the corresponding firmware has already been deployed to the programmer, skip the steps in the following subsections.
